svg.title: QuantumShield: post-quantum crypto-agility toolkit
svg.desc: Wordmark over a 2-D lattice. A noisy target point t and its closest lattice point v are ringed: the closest-vector problem behind ML-KEM. Read-outs: X25519MLKEM768 (0x11EC), ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203), ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204).
